name: Furrbit
notes: Furrbit: a round cream bunny with long pink-lined ears, brown paws and a white puff tail. Type NORMAL. Moves: Tackle (A), Quick Attack (B) and Growl (R). Walks at full speed: its move 1 (Tackle) reaches 1 tile, and the farther a monster's move 1 reaches, the slower it walks. As the player's monster it starts every run, classic or waves, with 20% more HP (72 instead of 60; each level still adds 8), because its Normal moves are super effective on no type and Ghosts shrug them off. Its attacks have a 50 % chance to hit twice (double_hit 50), as the player, a wild monster or the Alpha, in every mode: when a damaging move (Tackle, Quick Attack) lands, a coin flip can make every monster it hit take the same blow again 12 ticks (0.2 s) later, with its own damage number, flash and hit sound, and 2X floats up over Furrbit's head. The second blow never misses and only deals damage. It can be the player, and the 8 species that aren't picked live on the map.
title: FURRBIT
